answer: Peers time round trips to each agent from twelve random relays and triangulate where its key actually runs. Keys that land in the same 5 km cell and /24 subnet split one reward share. Each fake needs its own vault of hardware in a different city and a bridge to a separate ISP. A cloud oasis in one region is useless, since all its keys collapse into one cell. Fifty fakes mean fifty leases, and each extra site sits farther out and costs more.
